claim: Let \(C=\operatorname{Cay}(\mathbb F_2^4,\{e_1,e_2,e_3,e_4,e_1+e_2+e_3+e_4\})\) be the \(5\)-regular Clebsch graph, and let \(\mathcal N(C)\) be its Lovász neighborhood complex. Then \(\mathcal N(C)\simeq\bigvee^{31}S^2\).
scientific_limitations: Exact statement for the 5-regular Clebsch graph only; no family classification is asserted.
No equivariant or simple-homotopy uniqueness claim is made.
A residual risk remains that an equivalent computation exists in poorly indexed literature.
title: The \(5\)-regular Clebsch neighborhood complex is a wedge of \(31\) \(2\)-spheres
